object.name: TuneSettings
object.description: What the ESCs play when the aircraft arms (ArmTune) and disarms (DisarmTune): a short motif sent note by note as uavcan.equipment.indication.BeepCommand (1080), which the ESC firmware plays on the motor while it is stopped. Notes longer than 400 ms are chained. Voices: AllTogether sends standard BeepCommand (every motor the same note); FourVoices sends uavcan.equipment.indication.NoteCommand per voice, so melody and bass land on different motors, at Volume 0..11. Play auditions a tune right away (it returns to None); Save does not keep it. Needs ESC firmware that implements BeepCommand (the Vimdrones AM32 build in this tree).
